StatefulDetectorHandler.evaluate docstring incorrectly states it returns a list of DetectorEvaluationResult when it actually returns dict[DetectorGroupKey, DetectorEvaluationResult]

test_thread_queue_parallel_error_handling asserts test_partition not in committed_offsets, but worker finally completes the failed offset, causing the 1s commit loop to commit it and making the test flaky
